dedupe_keys.name: open wind energy site constraint toolkit

description: Open Wind Energy is a GIS toolkit for preparing onshore wind-turbine site constraints. It automates the retrieval and processing of spatial layers, creates turbine-specific exclusion or suitability maps, and offers local viewers for inspecting results. Users supply a target area, turbine dimensions and constraint settings; outputs include GeoJSON, shapefiles, GeoPackage, vector tiles and QGIS layers. Geographic coverage depends on the available upstream GIS datasets. MIT source, Docker quick-start instructions and a workflow description are public. A limitation is that a map of apparent available land does not establish planning permission, grid capacity or measured wind yield, and upstream land datasets need current verification. The toolkit can screen sites before detailed wind-farm and power-network simulation. The related catalogue PyPSA model optimises electricity systems, not land permissions. No GIS layer, Docker image or package was downloaded.
